name: PersistentDebtScreeningCompleted
trigger: SVC-001 completes persistent debt screening by calculating interest_paid_18m vs principal_repaid_18m from the account transaction ledger. Sets persistent_debt_status on OverdraftReview.
capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-001 (SVC-001). Internal state progression event.

payload_schema.persistent_debt_months: integer — cumulative months in persistent debt

consumers.action: Feeds into review decision logic at PH-086. Persistent debt status influences the decision: 18-month triggers intervention terms; 36-month triggers suspension.
Records persistent debt screening result for FCA CONC 6.7 compliance evidence.

ordering_guarantees: Per-account ordering. Follows EVT-115 for the same review_id.
worm_rationale: FCA CONC 6.7 requires evidence that persistent debt screening was performed and the correct intervention was applied. 7-year retention.
